messages:
morgan: Quick FYI — starting an experiment to route a small grace-cohort of v1 clients to v2-compatible fallbacks for 48h. Aim: validate latency + regressions before wide deprec. Thoughts?

alina: tl;dr yes. A couple things: console needs explicit badge + timeline, and we should surface per-tenant error delta. Also need quota smoothing to avoid sudden 429s.

devon: Agree. Proposal: 2% of tokens routed, ramp to 5% if 5xx delta < 0.1% and p99 latency delta < 20ms. Abort if 5xx delta > 0.5% for any tenant.

samir: How are we computing 5xx delta? noisy for low-traffic tenants. Suggest rolling aggregate with Bayesian smoothing + require min requests threshold.

morgan: Good call. Let's use min_requests=500 in 24h window + Laplace smoothing. Also want to flag any quality regressions via eval prompt set.

ira: Console side: show 'compat probe' badge, link to detailed telemetry, and an opt-out button for tenants with enterprise flag. UI copy: 'Routing probe: v1->v2 fallback (in trial) — contact support to opt-out'.

ben: Operational note: need to ensure quota math accounts for extra token cost when rerouting to v2. We should backfill token-metering delta and not throttle early.

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout started for routing-probe v1->v2-fallback cohort 'grace-A' (2% traffic).

alina: Telemetry hooks: capture trace_id, route_variant, client_version, tenant_id. Store a 'compat_flag' in traces so console can filter. Add per-request tag for 'fallback_reason'.

devon: Will implement metrics: compat.requests, compat.5xx, compat.latency.p50/p99, compat.quality.regressions. Sampling: 1 in 10 full traces, 100% metric counts.

samir: Also add a dashboard tile with cohort histogram and per-tenant sparkline. And an alert: if any tenant's 5xx rate increases by > 300% vs baseline AND absolute >0.3%, page eng-oncall.

morgan: :thumbsup: I'll update the runbook with abort conditions and rollback steps. Can someone PR the console banner copy?

alina: I'll do the PR after lunch. Also adding a small 'why' modal explaining deprecation timeline.

ops-bot: incident: auto-monitor created - routing-probe 'grace-A' - watchlist: 12 tenants flagged.

morgan: Thanks. We'll sync tomorrow in the 9am eng-platform standup to pick signals and finalize the console affordance.
